scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games for the Year
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Odisha or have stayed in the state for at least 7 years
Applicant must have achieved outstanding performance in any recognized sport during the year
Applicant must not have been convicted of any criminal offence
Applicant must not be found positive for use of drugs or banned substances
Award can be given only once to an individual in their lifetime
Award may be given posthumously to the next of kin of the sportsperson
Award may be cancelled and recovered if obtained by fraudulent means
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹2,00,000 along with a statue, scroll of honour, blazer with tie and travel allowances (T.A. and D.A.)
